items.title: Define retired-root configuration semantics
items.context: Add a small config surface that can mark a project root retired and identify canonicalRoot, without changing normal project behavior.
items.userSees: Configuration supports exact retired-root state: config contains `retiredRoot: true` and `canonicalRoot: "/Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound"`; proofbound config does not print a retired-root warning.

happy.desc: A project config with retiredRoot true and canonicalRoot resolves to a typed retired-root policy.

edge.desc: A normal proofbound config without retiredRoot behaves exactly as before and does not emit a retired-root warning.

adversarial.desc: A retiredRoot config without canonicalRoot fails with an actionable config error instead of silently allowing writes.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke passed: retiredRoot true with canonicalRoot is classified and mutating commands are blocked while read-only commands stay available.
Focused smoke passed: non-retired config leaves story_create unchanged and diagnostic validate without --story stays read-only.
Focused smoke passed: retiredRoot true without canonicalRoot fails closed and explains canonicalRoot is not configured.

items.title: Enforce retired-root guard before mutating commands
items.context: Use existing command policy ownership classes so read-only commands remain available and story/checklist/validate/evidence writes fail closed with a canonical-root message.
items.userSees: From `/Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate`, `lattice story_create ...` exits nonzero and prints `Lattice root is retired: /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate` plus `Use canonicalRoot: /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound`; `lattice session_brief` still prints the legacy brief.

happy.desc: Mutating workflow commands in a retired root are rejected before handler dispatch with canonicalRoot recovery text.

edge.desc: Read-only workflow commands in a retired root remain available for evidence inspection.

adversarial.desc: Story, checklist, review, validation, and evidence-writing commands cannot bypass the retired-root guard through normal CLI invocation.

verificationEvidence.note: Command exited 1 as expected and printed both "Lattice root is retired: /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate" and "Use canonicalRoot: /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound" before handler dispatch.
Read-only retired-root inspection still works and reports legacy Orchestrate state without creating new story metadata.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:retired-root-guard && npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke covers story_create, checklist_update, validate --story, review_pass_set, and story_discard blocking; ownership contract confirms dynamic validate/read-only boundaries still resolve as ruled.

items.title: Add focused tests for retired-root behavior
items.context: Verify read-only commands still work, mutating commands are rejected, and explicit override is narrow and auditable.
items.userSees: `npm --prefix packages/main run test:retired-root-guard` prints PASS for read-only allowed, mutating rejected, missing canonicalRoot rejected, and explicit override behavior either absent or auditable.

happy.desc: Focused retired-root smoke proves read-only commands pass and representative mutating commands fail closed.

edge.desc: Smoke proves non-retired proofbound behavior is unchanged and version/build output still works.

adversarial.desc: Smoke proves malformed retired-root config and bypass attempts do not silently permit writes.

items.title: Document Orchestrate retirement and migration recovery path
items.context: Record that B-3523 and B-fbb6 were migrated into proofbound worktrees and that Orchestrate is read-only legacy evidence.
items.userSees: `docs/requirements/decisions/orchestrate-retirement.md` says Orchestrate is read-only legacy evidence, proofbound is canonical, and B-3523/B-fbb6 were preserved under proofbound `.worktrees`.

happy.desc: Documentation states the canonical proofbound root and the retired Orchestrate role without host-specific wording.

edge.desc: Documentation preserves local evidence use and does not instruct users to delete legacy story evidence.

adversarial.desc: Documentation does not claim B-3523/B-fbb6 business work is finished or that old Orchestrate remains active.

items.title: Verify migrated active stories are visible in proofbound and absent from Orchestrate active worktrees
items.context: User-observable migration acceptance: B-3523 and B-fbb6 must be recoverable at /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound/.worktrees/*, while /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate no longer has story/B-3523 or story/B-fbb6 worktrees/branches.
items.userSees: `test -d /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound/.worktrees/B-3523` and `test -d /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound/.worktrees/B-fbb6` succeed; `git -C /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate worktree list` has no active `B-3523` or `B-fbb6` worktree path.

happy.desc: Proofbound contains recoverable B-3523 and B-fbb6 worktree directories.

edge.desc: Old Orchestrate no longer has active story/B-3523 or story/B-fbb6 branches or healthy active worktrees.

adversarial.desc: Any remaining Orchestrate lab/temp worktrees are reported separately and not misrepresented as active migrated stories.
